input.text: This applies under section 121 of the Data Protection Act 2018.

references.literal: section 121 of the Data Protection Act 2018

_note: Host_instrument_number is given here (deliberately a non-matching, irrelevant EU-shaped number -- this is a UK Act) but host_instrument_name genuinely matches. The by-NAME check must run and resolve INTERNAL regardless of the number mismatch. Fix 's own bug nested the by-name elif UNDER the outer 'if host_instrument_number:' gate, so whenever a number was given at all -- matching or not -- the by-name check never even ran; this text would then have wrongly become EXTERNAL to 'Data Protection Act 2018'.
